norm_ppf_parity.note: the fast Acklam Phi^-1 against the scalar-erf Newton reference. The rank_normal target is a MONOTONE relabel, so a difference at this scale cannot reorder anything.

detection_control.purpose: harness liveness. Same battery, same B, same pools, pointed at a change known to be resolvable. If this does not fire, the twenty nulls in this lane are uninformative.
detection_control.expected: resolvable LOSS on the ridge leg; muted on the blend leg
detection_control.reading: cells firing on the ridge leg under BOTH estimators, out of 4. A count of 0 would mean this lane's twenty nulls are uninformative.
